completion_promises.criterion_text: planner.py imports no model/LLM/dispatch/NATS modules — enforced by an AST-level import-allowlist test (stdlib + planning-package + stage_taxonomy only); this is the deterministic no-reasoning-model predicate
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented AST-based import allowlist test in test_planner.py::TestImportAllowlist::test_planner_module_imports_only_allowed_modules. The test parses planner.py and checks for forbidden imports (langchain, openai, anthropic, nats, dispatch, subagents, executor). Test passes — planner.py only imports from collections.abc, dataclasses, typing, and forge.pipeline.stage_taxonomy.

completion_promises.criterion_text: plan_next_step is total and pure: every history shape yields exactly one PlanningDecision (DispatchProductOwner / PauseAtCheckpoint / ExecuteHandoff / Fail(reason) / BoundaryViolation); a repeated-call test proves same-history-in -> same-decision-out
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented plan_next_step as a pure function with no I/O or side effects. Two tests verify this: (1) test_plan_next_step_returns_decision_for_empty_history verifies totality (empty history yields a decision), (2) test_plan_next_step_is_pure_same_history_yields_same_decision verifies purity (calling twice with same history yields identical decisions). All five decision types (DispatchProductOwner, PauseAtCheckpoint, ExecuteHandoff, Fail, BoundaryViolation) are implemented as frozen dataclasses.

completion_promises.criterion_text: History containing any PLANNING_FORBIDDEN_STAGES entry -> BoundaryViolation decision (never advance), designed to be recorded as a boundary error by the caller
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented boundary check as first step in plan_next_step (before any other logic). PLANNING_FORBIDDEN_STAGES frozenset contains all build stages: ARCHITECT, SYSTEM_ARCH, SYSTEM_DESIGN, FEATURE_SPEC, FEATURE_PLAN, AUTOBUILD, PULL_REQUEST_REVIEW, TASK_REVIEW, TASK_WORK. Three tests verify boundary violations: test_history_with_autobuild_returns_boundary_violation, test_history_with_pull_request_review_returns_boundary_violation, test_history_with_feature_spec_returns_boundary_violation. All pass.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Dispatch-failure outcomes (StageDispatchOutcome.ERROR / failed status in history) map to Fail(reason) with the dispatch failure as the reason
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented dispatch-failure check in plan_next_step that inspects history for status='failed' or status='error' and returns Fail(reason) with details from the event. Two tests verify this: (1) test_history_with_failed_status_returns_fail_decision checks status='failed', (2) test_history_with_error_outcome_returns_fail_decision checks status='error'. Both tests verify that Fail decision is returned with appropriate reason string.
